title: Enforce signed protected-ref policies during push
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Enforce signed protected-ref policies during push
events.body:
## Outcome

Prevent destructive updates to protected branches and tags while preserving normal push behavior for unprotected refs.

## Implementation

- Define `.forkmesh/push-policy.json` with a versioned schema, protected-ref globs, delete and non-fast-forward rules, allowed repository roles, owner identity, timestamp, and signature.
- Define machine-readable canonical signing vectors for the policy.
- Pass the authenticated pusher identity and resolved role through the relay tunnel to `RepoHost`.
- Enforce the policy atomically before refs update. A missing policy preserves current behavior; a present but malformed or invalidly signed policy rejects the push.
- Return a clear receive-pack rejection and refresh integrity state only after an accepted push.

## Acceptance criteria

- Owner and delegated-writer paths are covered.
- Delete and force-push are rejected for protected refs and allowed for unprotected refs when policy permits.
- Invalid signatures, unknown roles, and malformed rules fail closed.
- A multi-ref push never partially updates when one command violates policy.
- Standard Git clients display the denial reason.

## Dependencies

Depends on #435 for the receive-pack compatibility harness.

## Verification

Add accepted fast-forward, rejected delete, rejected non-fast-forward, allowed unprotected force-push, role, invalid-policy, and mixed multi-ref cases.
